title: prunus salicina var. mandshurica
intro: Prunus salicina var. mandshurica, commonly known as the Manchurian plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It is known for its use in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its numerous health benefits, including the potential to treat fever, cough, and sore throat. The therapeutic actions of Prunus salicina var. mandshurica include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Prunus salicina var. mandshurica also exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
